_readme: Jobs, houses and money. Numbers here are the main balance levers.

jobs: label, cat (rest / staff / escort), energy (weekly cost), skill (which skill she uses), needs (amenity required), room (uses a bedroom), must (must-offer role: she serves propositions from her menu and expects them; other jobs choose, see data/balance.json → props), desc. jobTrust: trust she needs for a job she doesn't particularly like. Removed jobs: companion (now courtesan), reception (now promoter).

slots: positions per house. Keys: base, amenity ids (bar, stage, guard, bath), perSize (one more per N building size), perRoom (per bedroom), min / perRooms (one per N bedrooms, at least min), as (same number as another job), byJob (equal to active workers in that job), madameBase / madameStep (extra slots when a madame works in the house: madameBase + floor(madameScore / madameStep)). A job with no entry (promoter, maid) is unlimited. Courtesans: 4 (+1 to +6 with a madame at 1000 cap); attendants: one per courtesan working in the house.

propRate / propWhere: base chance per client visit that a staff job gets propositioned, and where it happens (reports). The bar, her propRate fx and her appeal multiply it. Courtesans are asked through the normal client flow (balance.json → jobs.propWant), so their entry is 0.

classes: client classes; mult = how much they pay; wants = how much more (or less) often they ask for a service, by service id; tech = mean technique (0.3-1.4); prop = chance a visiting client of this class makes a proposition to staff; rowdy = chance of bar trouble; reckless = how reckless/forceful (adds half to pushy; a Bar adds more); pushy = chance to try to force it after hearing no. tier: the old four classes (commoner, adventurer, merchant, noble) that houses' clientele weights (houses cls, 4 numbers) and ladies' classBonus/classLike fall back to; share: weight within its tier; traits: x weights for client traits (balance.json → clients.traits) for this class. stats = {stat: weight} stat taste (balance.json → clients.statPref): his draw, satisfaction and fee follow how high her stats are. Regulars keep their class taste.

upgrades with a "race" field are race houses (tether = spirits, charger = androids, chapel = angels, sigil = demons; the garden, incense burner, workshop, laundry, classroom have no race). amenity effect numbers are in balance.json → amenities. Races with "needs" in races.json can't be recruited into or moved to a house without that upgrade. upgrades.mood (race houses): weekly mood bonus for ladies of that race working or living in the house.

beds / floorRest: staff beds and how much they rest. amenitySize: building space each amenity takes (0 = takes no room). decor: house décor tiers (h.decor, label / cost; demand and upkeep per tier are in balance.json → amenities.decor). drinks: the bar's drinks menu tiers (h.drinks 0-3, needs the Bar, no room; income and proposition multipliers and upkeep per tier are in balance.json → amenities.drinks). classroom + teacher job: one teacher per house teaches a skill (h.teachSkill, null = her best tech skill) to the others (balance.json → amenities.classroom). A job with "race" is only for that race. An upgrade with "needs" requires another upgrade built first. racePerks: shown on sheets (the effects live in data/races.json and code).
roomMult / roomNames / roomTierCost: client room tiers. prices: house price levels (mult = fee multiplier, demand = client multiplier).

houses: every house. cls = clientele weights [commoner, adventurer, merchant, noble]. rep = starting popularity (how well known the house is). prestige = starting class/prestige (0-100, how upscale it is: drives client class, expectations, and propositions vs refinements). npc = the named lady who comes with it (characters.json). setting = image backdrop. starter = pickable at the start; premium houses unlock with level / renown; ngplus = unlocks from cycle 2. damaged = sealed/damaged rooms that subtract from usable size until repaired. perk = {label, desc} displayed in UI; mechanical perk fields (repGain, propMult, bathMult, restMult, barMult, classFee, danceMult, popGain, feeMult, chapelMult, chapelPropCoin, chargeMult, skillGain, moodRest, buildDisc, incenseMult, trainMult) are read by logic.

pasts: Sam's past lives at the start; sam = his starting stat bonuses. Other past perks (books, bar income, recovery, training, feasts, trust from chats and dates, tidiness and class drift) are in code (hasPast).
upgrades.mood (race houses): weekly mood bonus for ladies of that race working or living in the house.
hauntRep (haunted houses): house popularity at which the haunting stops scaring clients off (demand ramps from 45% to 125% of normal by then; default 40).
lodging: weekly room-and-board income from travelers, x(1 + popularity/50). sat: flat satisfaction bonus for every client (a welcoming house).
tiers: the four client tiers, in the order of houses → cls. Host (job host): entertains clients waiting for a courtesan; see balance.json → clients.wait / clients.host.
houses[id].goddess / pasts[k].goddess {intro, again}: the goddess's remarks about them (js/logic/goddess.js).

madame.label: Madame
madame.desc: Runs the house: calmer moods, prevents overwork, +1 courtesan position (+1 more per 200 Management/Wits/Charm/Charisma, up to +6 at 1000), clients matched to willing & skilled ladies, and pairs bonded attendants. Steps in for overwhelmed courtesans; can be propositioned.

promoter.label: Promoter
promoter.desc: Draws clients and house popularity. She eases off when last week's crowd was more than the house could take (Wits: how well she reads it; a friend on security helps). Free samples boost draw and her own popularity, tire her out, and raise or lower house class depending on how she compares to the house's prestige. Unlimited positions.

attendant.label: Attendant
attendant.desc: The madame's and courtesans' assistant: eases workload and fatigue, keeps clients happier, and builds a bond with her paired courtesan for extra trust. Can cover services a tired or unwilling courtesan refuses, and steps in when courtesans are swamped.

security.label: Security
security.desc: Handles pushy clients, screens out troublemakers for higher-value guests (Wits), and keeps excess crowds at the door for minimal penalty (Charm/Charisma). Builds trust.

bartender.label: Bartender
bartender.desc: Sells drinks. Needs a Bar. The house gets more propositions, more rowdiness and more reckless clients.

dancer.label: Dancer
dancer.desc: Draws crowds, earns tips, builds popularity. Expects propositions and serves them from her menu.

bath.label: Bath Attendant
bath.desc: Tends the bathhouse; always offers bathers a massage. Expects propositions and serves them from her menu.

teacher.label: Teacher
teacher.desc: Teaches one subject (a trade skill or a service, chosen below) to every lady in the house who is behind her in it. Humans learn faster. Takes no clients. One position.

maid.label: Maid
maid.desc: Keeps the house tidy (tidiness drives house popularity, prestige, mood and rest). Wears a maid uniform while on the job. Unlimited positions.

chapel.label: Chapel Keeper
chapel.desc: Tends the Quiet Chapel: draws house and personal popularity, prestige, and donations (other races work at half effectiveness, and visitors are disappointed if no angel works as chapel keeper, host, security or maid). Visitors often proposition her discreetly—willing keepers earn extra house popularity and higher donations instead of service fees. Two positions.

courtesan.label: Courtesan
courtesan.desc: Offers her service menu to everyone. Lowest comfort lines, can work when not in the mood. Uses a room for services.

host.label: Host
host.desc: Keeps clients company while they wait for a courtesan: conversation, drinks, and a little warming up for those open to it (light services out in the lounge, never to the finish). A skilled host keeps people waiting longer and happier, and her warm-ups make courtesans—especially novices—far more effective. Can be propositioned, which takes her off the floor for a while.

guild.label: Guild Contract
guild.desc: Away on an Adventurers' Guild contract for the week (from any house): progress from the contract's stats, gold and merit when it's done, stat practice and trust, and a risk of injury (Health). Pick the contract on the Guild tab.

decor.label: Bare walls
decor.desc: Plain plaster and whatever the last owner left.

decor.label: Lanterns and a signboard
decor.desc: Warm lamps by the door and a sign people can actually read.

decor.label: Paintings and drapes
decor.desc: Framed paintings, heavy curtains, a proper entrance hall.

decor.label: Gilded décor
decor.desc: Gilt mirrors, chandeliers and a doorman's carpet. Nobles take notice.

drinks.label: House ale
drinks.desc: Watered-down ale and whatever is in the cask.

drinks.label: Good wine
drinks.desc: A proper wine list and clean glasses.

drinks.label: Imported vintages
drinks.desc: Cellared vintages from across the sea, poured by the glass.

drinks.label: Dwarven spirits & elven wine
drinks.desc: Rare spirits and moon-ripened wine. Patrons linger, spend and get ideas.

human.label: Adaptable
human.desc: Trust, skills, stats and lewdness grow 25% faster; learns 50% more in the classroom. Signing bonuses are 20% lower.

elf.label: Long-lived
elf.desc: Mood changes slowly and settles slowly, for better and worse. Nobles pay 20% more, merchants 5%. Thrives in a garden.

beastkin.label: Simple needs
beastkin.desc: Asks for 15% lower wages, recovers 15% more energy and her lewdness grows 15% faster. Gets restless sooner, feels incense more strongly, and takes it hard when Sam turns her down.

demon.label: Feeds on desire
demon.desc: Services cost 40% less energy, and clients who finish feed her. Sleep does little for her and a working week burns energy. Restless, she can drain a client dry. Higher lust ceiling (+20), lust builds 30% faster.

dwarf.label: Hardy
dwarf.desc: +25 max energy, recovers 25% more from rest, builds lust 25% more slowly. Bartends 15% better. A house with a Workshop gets cheaper to improve while dwarves live there.

spirit.label: Incorporeal
spirit.desc: Needs no bed, but needs a Tethering Stone to live here. Recovers a steady amount every week. Moods swing hard but settle fast. Adventurers pay 30% more and seek her out. Can reverse-possess clients, Sam, or a willing housemate—keeping her body while borrowing his cock.

angel.label: Serene
angel.desc: Lower lust ceiling (-30), never reckless, resting mood +5. Can keep a Quiet Chapel (Chapel Keeper, where willing propositions earn house popularity and donations). High lewdness can awaken her as a Lantern Angel. Nobles are especially fond of her.

android.label: Rechargeable
android.desc: Needs a Charging Alcove and no bed. Rest charges her to full (for a fee). Skills grow 25% faster, +10 max energy, bad moods hit 40% softer, lust builds slowly. Tailors her hair, eyes and figure per client on shift (for draw, fees and satisfaction); un-keyed models can also be customized on her sheet. Merchants pay 20% more.

guard.label: Guard Post
guard.desc: Security is much more effective. Takes no room.

bath.label: Bathhouse
bath.desc: +mood, +satisfaction. Unlocks Bath Attendant job and bath scenes.

tether.label: Tethering Stone
tether.desc: Spirits can live and work here. Takes 1 room; while one stands (in any house), spirit candidates turn up more often.

charger.label: Charging Alcove
charger.desc: Androids can live and work here. Recharge fee -40%. Takes 1 room; while one stands (in any house), android candidates turn up more often.

chapel.label: Quiet Chapel
chapel.desc: Angel mood +4 (+3 weekly mood for the whole house while an angel keeps the chapel). Unlocks the Chapel Keeper job (angels only, 2 positions): a keeper adds house and personal popularity each week, and visitors leave donations.

sigil.label: Binding Sigil
sigil.desc: A demon's reckless drain costs no house popularity or prestige, and demons in this house take only half as much energy from Sam. Takes no room.

garden.label: Garden
garden.desc: Everyone in the house gains a little mood and mends a little wear (Health) each week. Elves get double. Takes no room.

incense.label: Incense Burner
incense.desc: Pick one mutually exclusive incense blend at a time (Calming Lavender, Crimson Lotus, Scholar's Cedar, Velvet Myrrh, or Brisk Ambergris). Beastkin feel every effect 60% stronger. Takes no room.

workshop.label: Workshop
workshop.desc: Each dwarf living here (any job) shaves a little off the markup on your next build in this house, up to all of it. Resets after each purchase. Takes no room.

laundry.label: Laundry
laundry.desc: The house gets messy more slowly. Takes no room.

classroom.label: Classroom
classroom.desc: A teacher (one position) drills the house in one subject each week. Choose the subject on the house view or the teacher's sheet.

suite.label: Owner's Suite
suite.desc: Sam's own room in this house. When he sleeps here, his bed is one tier better than the staff's.

lantern.name: The Gilded Lantern

perk.label: Lantern Charm
perk.desc: +30% house popularity gain and +20% staff proposition rate.

lantern.desc: A classic pleasure house: red velvet, paper lanterns, and a madame who knows everyone in town. Balanced clientele.
lantern.setting: red velvet and gold-trimmed fantasy pleasure house
lantern.goddess: "The Gilded Lantern." {goddess} sounds innocent. "I may have nudged the old owner's luck. Mira's already decided you're hers to mother, so mind your manners. Or don't."

castle.name: Castle Rosenhal

perk.label: Old Nobility
perk.desc: Nobles pay 20% higher service fees here.

castle.desc: A crumbling hilltop manor turned discreet retreat for the wealthy. Few guests, very deep pockets, very high standards.
castle.setting: grand old castle chamber with tall windows and faded tapestries
castle.goddess: "Castle Rosenhal. Noble Hill." {goddess} looks very pleased. "I stood on those ramparts when the count still had a mind. Cecile will fold you into shape. I wouldn't mind watching it."

onsen.name: Steamveil Onsen

perk.label: Mineral Springs
perk.desc: +25% bathhouse earnings and +15% energy recovery on rest.

onsen.desc: Hot springs on the road to the dungeons. Tired adventurers, cheap sake, and a lot of steam.
onsen.setting: wooden onsen inn with paper screens and rising steam
onsen.goddess: {goddess} lets a long, contented sigh drift through the steam. "A hot spring. I had no ulterior motive, none at all. Tsubaki sings dreadfully, you'll love it."

hollow.name: Hollowmere Manor

perk.label: Haunted Infamy
perk.desc: Starts with a Tethering Stone; once house popularity reaches 55, thrill-seekers raise demand up to 125%.

hollow.desc: Dirt cheap because it's haunted. The ghost is part of the staff now. Customers barely trickle in at first, but thrill-seekers flock once its popularity grows.
hollow.setting: gothic manor room with candelabras, cobwebs and moonlight
hollow.goddess: "Hollowmere Manor, dirt cheap, because it's haunted." {goddess} smiles into her lantern. "I know Vesper. We've shared a candle or two. Be nice to her, she's been waiting three centuries for you."

tankard.name: The Rusty Tankard

perk.label: Dockside Pour
perk.desc: +25% bartender earnings and +20% staff proposition rate.

tankard.desc: A tiny tavern with rooms upstairs. Cheap, loud, always busy. Nobles do not come here.
tankard.setting: cramped tavern room above a dockside bar
tankard.goddess: "The Rusty Tankard! Noisy, cheap and crowded." {goddess} grins. "Hilde lost a brewery to a giant, and she still owes me a pint. Collect it for me, would you?"

pavilion.name: Moonlit Pavilion

perk.label: Moonlit Stage
perk.desc: +25% dancer tips & draw, and +25% popularity gained here.

pavilion.desc: A garden pavilion of music and moon-lilies. Refined, artistic, unhurried.
pavilion.setting: elven garden pavilion with moon-lilies and silk drapes
pavilion.goddess: "The Moonlit Pavilion." {goddess} swirls a lantern like a lily on a pond. "Sylphine will make you clap, I promise. Don't let her out-dazzle me."

veil.name: The Crimson Veil

perk.label: Velvet Underworld
perk.desc: +30% lewdness growth, +15% escort service fees, and +50% trouble risk.

veil.desc: A demon-run den beneath the streets. Anything goes, within reason. Trouble walks in often. Staff get bolder here.
veil.setting: dim underground den with crimson silk and red lanterns
veil.goddess: "The Crimson Veil. Underdistrict." {goddess} looks entirely too innocent. "Zaria and I go way back. She keeps a ledger of favors, and I may be in it. Play nice with the demon, Sam."

sanctuary.name: Dawnlight Cloister

perk.label: Heaven on Earth
perk.desc: Built-in Quiet Chapel; +60% chapel donations & popularity, +3 guest satisfaction, and willing chapel propositions leave +40g offerings.

sanctuary.desc: A sunlit cloister built around an active Quiet Chapel—known across the Lantern Quarter as a place to experience heaven on earth.
sanctuary.setting: sunlit sandstone cloister chapel with stained glass, white silk curtains, and glowing lanterns
sanctuary.goddess: "Dawnlight Cloister." {goddess} arches a brow as warm bell-light spills across your palms. "Caelia already wears the lantern, and half the quarter thinks confession comes with silk sheets. Try not to blush when the pilgrims tip."

atelier.name: The Clockwork Atelier

perk.label: Precision Conduits
perk.desc: Built-in Charging Alcove; -40% extra android recharge cost and +20% skill growth for everyone here.

atelier.desc: A brass-and-glass workshop turned sleek pleasure house with private power conduits. Popular with merchants and tinkerers.
atelier.setting: warm brass-and-glass clockwork salon with humming copper conduits and velvet divans
atelier.goddess: "The Clockwork Atelier." {goddess} taps a fingernail against a humming brass conduit. "Someone wired an android's cradle right into the parlor walls. Nadia remembers every guest's favorite rhythm—mostly because she logs it."

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer's Rest

perk.label: Open Hearth
perk.desc: 140g/wk lodging (scales with popularity), +4 client satisfaction, and +1 candidate recruit.

wayfarer.desc: A caravan inn where every road meets. Travelers pay for room and board, the hearth puts every guest at ease, and there's a steady stream of job-seekers.
wayfarer.setting: cozy roadside inn room with a crackling hearth
wayfarer.goddess: "Every road meets at the Wayfarer's Rest." {goddess} sounds smug. "Including yours. Bettina reads boots and hats, but she doesn't know about me. Yet."

skyhook.name: The Skyhook

perk.label: Shore Leave Fever
perk.desc: +20% bartender earnings, +25% staff proposition rate, and +30% trouble risk.

skyhook.desc: A rowdy lounge bolted to the cliffside airship moorings. Sky-sailors, traders and treasure hunters, all with full purses and short shore leave.
skyhook.setting: lantern-lit airship dock lounge with brass fittings, rope rigging and a view over the clouds
skyhook.goddess: "The Skyhook, bolted to a cliff." {goddess} laughs and shades her eyes. "I borrowed Rinna's wreck for a night once. She tells tall tales, but this one is true."

pearl.name: The Pearl Grotto

perk.label: Tidepool Serenity
perk.desc: +30% bathhouse earnings, +2 weekly mood, and +10% energy recovery on rest.

pearl.desc: A hidden sea-cave bathhouse beneath the harbor, lit by glowing pearls. Very exclusive, very relaxing, and nobody is quite sure who built it.
pearl.setting: luxurious sea-cave grotto with glowing pearls, warm tide pools and carved stone
pearl.goddess: "The Pearl Grotto." For once {goddess} pauses before she answers. "Maris was old when I was young. Nobody knows who built it. I may know, but I won't say. Go on, relax."

foundry.name: Ironwood Hall

perk.label: Grand Shell
perk.desc: Highest natural capacity (18 rooms total; 8 start damaged until repaired), built-in Workshop, and -15% upgrade costs.

foundry.desc: A cavernous, run-down manor beside the old forges. Half the wings are nailed shut and dusty, yet its dwarf warden swears it could outgrow the castle once repaired.
foundry.setting: vast run-down timber-and-stone hall with iron lanterns, tool benches, and freshly planed oak
foundry.goddess: "Ironwood Hall!" {goddess} peers up into the dusty rafters. "Half the doors are nailed shut and the drafts could lift a skirt, yet look at the footprint. Brynna's already got her hammer out."

conservatory.name: The Glass Conservatory

perk.label: Fragrant Glasshouse
perk.desc: Built-in Garden & Incense Burner; incense blends are 50% stronger here and every guest gets +3 satisfaction.

conservatory.desc: A vaulted botanical glasshouse warm with orchids, night-blooming jasmine, and brass censer vents piped straight into the suites.
conservatory.setting: warm vaulted glasshouse conservatory full of orchids, hanging ferns, and velvet daybeds
conservatory.goddess: "The Glass Conservatory." {goddess} inhales deeply, smiling. "Careful breathing too deep in there, Sam. Maren blends the censers herself, and the glass keeps every wisp inside."

lyceum.name: The Velvet Lyceum

perk.label: Master Salon
perk.desc: Built-in Classroom; +30% Sam practice & classroom teaching gains, and +15% skill growth.

lyceum.desc: A former noble finishing academy turned discreet salon. Mirror-lined practice halls and a lecture theater train staff to command top coin.
lyceum.setting: velvet-draped private academy salon with tall mirrors, lecture desks, and gilded sconces
lyceum.goddess: "The Velvet Lyceum." {goddess} chuckles behind her sleeve. "Vivienne used to grade young lords on posture and etiquette. Now she grades something considerably warmer."

shrine.name: The Lantern Shrine

perk.label: Lantern of Echoes
perk.desc: Bound to Seliora's embers. Room cap starts at 10 and grows +5 each NG++ cycle. Gains a house-wide bonus from total Reincarnations of everyone actively working here (+1.5% client fees, +2% trust & skill growth, +1% house popularity gain per reincarnation stack, up to 50).

shrine.desc: A quiet wooden shrine-house built around a bronze lantern that remembers every face you've loved. Compact at first, another wing opens whenever Sam crosses back through the dark.
shrine.setting: lantern-lit wooden shrine parlor with sliding lattice screens, warm cedar beams, and quiet alcove rooms
shrine.goddess: "The Lantern Shrine." {goddess} rests two fingers on the warm doorframe. "Small for a fresh start, with room for one unformed soul—and extra grace for anyone who already remembers your name."

salaryman.label: Office worker
salaryman.desc: Spreadsheets were his life. Business +20; his Office focus cuts more upkeep.

goddess.intro: "Eight years of spreadsheets. You reconciled other people's money for a living and nobody ever reconciled you." {goddess} sounds almost fond. "It'll come in handy. Debts are just ledgers that bite."
goddess.again: "Ah, the ledgers again." She sounds delighted. "Now you've got two lives' worth of columns. Try not to get lost in the margins."

bartender.label: Part-time bartender
bartender.desc: He can make a cocktail out of anything. Charm +12; working the Floor at a house with a bar earns 50% more.

goddess.intro: "A part-time bartender, hm." {goddess} turns an imaginary glass in her fingers. "Pouring drinks and listening to strangers. You were practicing for this and didn't even know."
goddess.again: "You remember the bar, too?" She grins. "Good. Charm like that shouldn't go to waste. Pour me one sometime."

gym.label: Gym regular
gym.desc: Thin, but surprisingly strong. Strength +20 (Watch and guild work); recovers more energy.

goddess.intro: "You went to the gym three times a week and never once looked at yourself in the mirror." {goddess} pokes your arm. "Thin, and sturdy underneath. I like a surprise."
goddess.again: "The gym rat, back again." She squeezes your bicep and pretends to be unimpressed. "Still thin. Still strong. Still mine to watch."

massage.label: Massage therapist
massage.desc: Good hands, zero experience otherwise. Technique +15; training is more effective.

goddess.intro: "Good hands and no idea what to do with them." {goddess} takes one of them and turns it over, studying it. "A massage therapist. I'll be keeping an eye on those."
goddess.again: "The hands, too." She holds out her shoulder with a martyred sigh. "For old time's sake. Purely professional."

tutor.label: Cram-school tutor
tutor.desc: Six years of drilling teenagers for entrance exams. Wits +15; his Classes focus and coaching go 20% further.

goddess.intro: "Six years of cram school, drilling teenagers for exams they'd forget." {goddess} tilts her head. "A teacher who never got a thank-you. Teach this house something, and I'll be thanking you myself."
goddess.again: "Teacher again." She folds her hands behind her back, mock-prim. "Tell me, professor, do I get extra credit for supervising you?"

planner.label: Event planner
planner.desc: He ran other people's parties for a living. Business +8, Charm +6; feasts cost 30% less and land 30% better.

goddess.intro: "You planned two hundred weddings and never once got asked to dance." {goddess} counts them off on her fingers. "Seating charts, cake tastings, a clipboard. Here, the party is yours. Try enjoying one."
goddess.again: "The party planner. Good." She is already rearranging invisible place cards. "Throw them a feast and put me at the head of the table. I won't come. Do it anyway."

support.label: Customer support rep
support.desc: Three years of listening to angry strangers until they calmed down. Charm +10; chats and dates build 20% more trust.

goddess.intro: "Three years on a headset, saying 'I understand how frustrating that must be' and meaning it." {goddess} tilts her head. "You listen. Do you know how rare that is in a man? The women here are going to notice."
goddess.again: "Oh, the listener again." She props her chin on her hand. "Go on, then. Ask me how my day was. I want to see the face you make."

concierge.label: Hotel night clerk
concierge.desc: He kept a business hotel spotless on the graveyard shift. Wits +6, Business +6; his houses lose tidiness 20% slower and settle into their class 30% faster.

goddess.intro: "Night shift at a business hotel. Folded towels, squared pillows, a front desk nobody thanked." {goddess} runs a finger along a lantern, checking for dust. "You'll keep a clean house. I like a clean house."
goddess.again: "The night clerk. You do love a tidy lobby." She yawns, very prettily. "Keep the lamps trimmed. Someone has to notice these things, and I'm busy."

courier.label: Bicycle courier
courier.desc: Four years of red lights, rain and shortcuts across Tokyo. Strength +8, Wits +8; guild parties he's part of (and the ladies he sends) make 15% more progress, and his Guild focus costs 5 less energy.

goddess.intro: "A bicycle courier." {goddess} sounds delighted. "Rain, traffic, a bag full of other people's urgent business, and you never once dropped a parcel. Hollowmere has roads too, darling. Longer ones, with teeth."
goddess.again: "The courier, back on his route." She nudges your calf with her foot as if checking the tires. "Still all legs. Try to come home from the Barrow in one piece this time."
